proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks in init/comm structures. Add enqueue because graphUsageMode changes strong-stream capture/mixing behavior and P2P plan channel-cap logic in enqueue/strongstream runtime planning. Add device-topology because per-peer P2P channel derivation and maxP2pPeers-based channel budgeting are implemented in topology path/channel computation, which is a distinct substantive behavior change.
